---
title: "Inferred Parasite Age, Dispersion and Mortality"
output: github_document
---

```{r include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

These plots show the relationship between observed mortality and the hierarchical parasite age parameters `mu_age` and `sigma_age`, separately for AQUAMAT and SEAQUAMAT.

`mu_age` represents the mean of the inferred latent parasite age distribution over the 48-hour asexual cycle. Its relationship with mortality is therefore modelled using a cyclic smooth so that 48 hours joins continuously to 0 hours.

`sigma_age` describes the standard deviation of the inferred latent parasite age distribution and is modelled using an ordinary smooth because it is not a circular quantity.

Lines show probabilities of death and shaded regions show 95% confidence intervals. Mortality is the observed clinical outcome; `mu_age` and `sigma_age` are parameters inferred by the hierarchical staging model under the fixed sequestration assumption.

```{r load = FALSE}
library(data.table)
HIERARCHICAL_FILE <- "Staging/Complete case/outputs/CSV/dat_all_hierarchical.csv"
dat_hierarchical <- fread(HIERARCHICAL_FILE)
```

```{r create = FALSE}
AQ_binary <- dat_hierarchical[Trial == "AQUAMAT" & outcome %in% c(0, 1) &
                              is.finite(mu_age) & is.finite(sigma_age),
                              .(ID, outcome, mu_age, sigma_age)]

SQ_binary <- dat_hierarchical[Trial == "SEAQUAMAT" & outcome %in% c(0, 1) &
                              is.finite(mu_age) & is.finite(sigma_age),
                              .(ID, outcome, mu_age, sigma_age)]

sigma_lower <- floor(min(c(AQ_binary$sigma_age, SQ_binary$sigma_age), na.rm = TRUE))
sigma_upper <- ceiling(max(c(AQ_binary$sigma_age, SQ_binary$sigma_age), na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r apply = FALSE}
# Apply generalised additive model function with outcome as dependent variable
# & mu_age & sigma_age as smooth terms
apply_gam <- function(my_binary) {
  mgcv::gam(outcome ~ s(mu_age, bs = "cc", k = 10) + s(sigma_age, k = 10),
            data = my_binary, family = binomial(), method = "REML",
            knots = list(mu_age = c(0, 48)))
}

# Save models to extract data from later
AQ_binary_model <- apply_gam(AQ_binary)
SQ_binary_model <- apply_gam(SQ_binary)
```

```{r predict = FALSE}
# ---- Create prediction curves ----
# Predict mortality across mu_age while holding sigma_age
# at its study-specific median
predict_mu_curve <- function(my_binary, my_model) {
  prediction_data <- data.frame(mu_age = seq(0, 48, length.out = 481),
                                sigma_age = median(my_binary$sigma_age))

  prediction <- predict(my_model, newdata = prediction_data, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE)

  prediction_data$fit <- plogis(prediction$fit)
  prediction_data$lower <- plogis(prediction$fit - 1.96*prediction$se.fit)
  prediction_data$upper <- plogis(prediction$fit + 1.96*prediction$se.fit)

  prediction_data
}

circular_mean_48 <- function(x) {
  theta <- 2*pi*x / 48
  phase <- atan2(mean(sin(theta)), mean(cos(theta)))
  (phase %% (2*pi)) * 48 / (2*pi)
}

# Predict mortality across sigma_age while holding mu_age
# at a study-specific reference value
predict_sigma_curve <- function(my_binary, my_model) {
  sigma_lower <- floor(min(my_binary$sigma_age, na.rm = TRUE))
  sigma_upper <- ceiling(max(my_binary$sigma_age, na.rm = TRUE))
  mu_reference <- circular_mean_48(my_binary$mu_age)

  prediction_data <- data.frame(mu_age = mu_reference,
                                sigma_age = seq(sigma_lower, sigma_upper, length.out = 201))

  prediction <- predict(my_model, newdata = prediction_data, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE)
  prediction_data$fit <- plogis(prediction$fit)

  prediction_data$lower <- plogis(prediction$fit - 1.96*prediction$se.fit)
  prediction_data$upper <- plogis(prediction$fit + 1.96*prediction$se.fit)
  prediction_data
}

AQ_mu_curve <- predict_mu_curve(AQ_binary, AQ_binary_model)
SQ_mu_curve <- predict_mu_curve(SQ_binary, SQ_binary_model)

AQ_sigma_curve <- predict_sigma_curve(AQ_binary, AQ_binary_model)
SQ_sigma_curve <- predict_sigma_curve(SQ_binary, SQ_binary_model)
```

```{r plot, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Load ggplot2
library(ggplot2)

# State IDDO colours
col <- c("#E31B23", "#EC767D", "#1481E7", "#8DD5F2")

mu_title <- paste0("Mortality across latent parasite-age centre for AQUAMAT ",
                   "(n = ", nrow(AQ_binary), ") & SEAQUAMAT (n = ", nrow(SQ_binary), ")")

sigma_title <- paste0("Mortality across latent parasite-age dispersion for AQUAMAT ",
                      "(n = ", nrow(AQ_binary), ") & SEAQUAMAT (n = ", nrow(SQ_binary), ")")

plot_mu <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = AQ_mu_curve, aes(x = mu_age, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = col[2], alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = AQ_mu_curve, aes(x = mu_age, y = fit, colour = "AQUAMAT"),
            linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_ribbon(data = SQ_mu_curve, aes(x = mu_age, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = col[4], alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = SQ_mu_curve, aes(x = mu_age, y = fit, colour = "SEAQUAMAT"),
            linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("AQUAMAT" = col[1], "SEAQUAMAT" = col[3]), name = "Key") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) + ggtitle(mu_title) +
  xlab("Latent parasite-age centre, mu_age (h)") +
  ylab("Fitted probability of death") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 48, 4), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1), limits = c(0, 1),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 48))

show(plot_mu)

plot_sigma <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = AQ_sigma_curve, aes(x = sigma_age, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = col[2], alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = AQ_sigma_curve, aes(x = sigma_age, y = fit, colour = "AQUAMAT"),
            linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_ribbon(data = SQ_sigma_curve, aes(x = sigma_age, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = col[4], alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = SQ_sigma_curve, aes(x = sigma_age, y = fit, colour = "SEAQUAMAT"),
            linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("AQUAMAT" = col[1], "SEAQUAMAT" = col[3]), name = "Key") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) + ggtitle(sigma_title) +
  xlab("Latent parasite-age dispersion, sigma_age (h)") +
  ylab("Fitted probability of death") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(floor(sigma_lower/2)*2, ceiling(sigma_upper/2)*2, 2),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1), limits = c(0, 1),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(sigma_lower, sigma_upper))

show(plot_sigma)
```
